approaches.name: digital assessment and EMIS for tracking learning outcomes and out-of-school children
approaches.description: The project builds digital classroom assessment, an upgraded Shiksha Setu EMIS and digitized student records to track learning, flag dropouts and reach out-of-school children. Practices: Digitally enabled classroom assessment system for literacy and numeracy milestones; Enhanced Shiksha Setu EMIS tracking learning outcomes and dropout early warning; Digitized student and household records for out-of-school mobilization and tracking.
approaches.why_innovative: New service: digital classroom assessment tracking learning milestones - cue: 'advanced analytics' | category Technological; adoption apply; judged in 2 round(s); context expanded; final check: digital core, in_use before 2019

extra_evidence.text:

time monitoring and insights to improve program design and delivery.

Shiksha Setu, the state's EMIS, will be enhanced to align with
the Vidya Samiksha Kendra guidelines issued by the Ministry of Education, GoI.

(ii) monitoring of student attendance, migration, and transfers to help detect early warning
signs of potential dropouts and enabling targeted support mechanisms;

(iii) enhancing community outreach and
parental engagement; and (iv) implementing a digitized system of student and household records to support mobilization,
outreach, and beneficiary tracking.
